- The NVDA–SK Group $500B partnership provides a concrete fundamental anchor below current price

Key observation: SK Hynix gained +3.24% on a day when NVDA fell −3.46% and the KOSPI declined. This positive divergence against both the peer (NVDA) and the index (KOSPI) indicates fundamental demand — not just index-tracking recovery.

Specific KRX volume figures for SK Hynix on July 27 are not available in current search results.
